scope: WSDM corrected diagnostic update; previous UMAP manuscript remains a separately frozen historical version.
test_status: Post-hoc correction using an already inspected test window; not a fresh independent confirmation sample.
same_day: Day-t articles ordered by frozen pre-test click counts; ties retain source-file order. This selects candidates, not model ranks.
compression_scope: Full 25-feature record versus 12-feature collapsed/early-fused records; not an equal-dimension or interaction-isolated experiment. Direct separation without interactions is additionally reported.
early_fusion: Five scalar-output fusers, five-fold stratified row-level cross-fitting inside training; not user-grouped or forward-chained cross-fitting.
no_e: Independent 150-setting selections for 9-feature control and 18-feature PEC. No-E early fusion uses the selected no-E PEC tree setting and selects among five fusers.
uncertainty: 2000 paired user-clustered bootstrap replicates; multinomial user multiplicities, query-weighted means; percentile intervals are exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted.
candidate_pool_redraw_status: Not completed: required article embeddings are absent from the fixed cache. Historical five-pool claims are not asserted for this revision.
joint_latent_status: Not current evidence: historical cross-fitted hidden-coordinate alignment is unresolved.
privacy: Aggregate metrics and configurations only; no source rows, per-query predictions, user IDs, text, embeddings, or fitted models.
